methodologyNotes: Roster covers eleven pin, pinless, and dual-function moisture meters spanning sub-$50 consumer pin meters to $700+ professional dual-function and concrete-specific instruments, verified 2026-08-05 against manufacturer product/spec pages (General Tools, Klein Tools, Extech/FLIR, Delmhorst, Wagner Meters, Lignomat, Protimeter, Tramex) where reachable, corroborated by authorized distributors and retailers (GlobalTestSupply, TEquipment, TestEquipmentDepot, Wallco, Forestry Suppliers, Tools4Flooring, ExtremeSuppliesStore, Sonin's own store). One seed model ("Tavool TH210") does not exist in any manufacturer or retailer catalog; its proposed replacement (a purported Tavool "MT270") could not be independently verified as a genuine Tavool SKU, so that entry was removed entirely rather than kept on unverifiable provenance. accessedAt 2026-08-05 throughout; priceUsd is left null only where no live retail price could be confirmed through reachable sources (never guessed).

products.name: General Tools MMD4E Pin-Type LCD Moisture Meter
products.priceNote: Sale price at GlobalTestSupply ($43.80); Woodcraft lists regular price $114.99, eBay listings seen as low as $28.05. General Tools' own site does not display a fixed consumer price.
products.provenance: General Tools' own product page confirms 5-50% wood / 1.5-33% building-material ranges, ±2% accuracy with 0.1% resolution, 0.3 in. (8mm) pins, backlit 99.9-count LCD, HOLD button, and low/medium/high audible+visual moisture-level tones. Weight (3 oz) and 9V battery/3-minute auto-off also confirmed on the manufacturer page. No verifiable directly-hosted product image URL could be resolved (manufacturer image paths returned placeholders on fetch), so the image field is omitted rather than guessed.

products.name: Klein Tools ET140 Pinless Moisture Meter
products.priceNote: Sale price at GlobalTestSupply ($49.97, list $70.78); Klein Tools' own site does not display consumer pricing (retailer locator only).

specs.display_type: Reverse-contrast LCD + 9-segment LED bar graph, 0.1% resolution

products.provenance: Klein Tools' own catalog page confirms a 1.25 x 2 in. EMF sensor pad, 0.75 in. (19mm) sensing depth, 0-100% relative reading with 0.1% resolution, ±4% accuracy, reverse-contrast display with 9-LED bar graph, mode button for the four calibrated materials, audible alert, and 1x9V battery power. Price not published by Klein directly; GlobalTestSupply sale/list pricing used as representative.

products.name: Extech MO55 Combination Pin/Pinless Moisture Meter
products.priceNote: Current retail at Wallco Inc ($124.00); Extech/FLIR's own site no longer lists a price and shows the MO55A as the current replacement model, though MO55 is still actively sold as of 2026-08-05 at TEquipment, Instrumentation2000, and Wallco.
products.provenance: Extech's own product page confirms combination pin/pinless operation, 5-50%/1.5-33% pin ranges, 0-99% pinless range, 0.1% resolution, ±(3%+5 digit) accuracy, ~1 in. (25mm) pinless sensing depth, low/medium/high icon display, audible alert that speeds up with moisture, 9V battery power, and 2-year warranty. Note: Extech's current site lists this exact form factor as discontinued in favor of the MO55A (near-identical specs, 3xAAA power), but MO55 remains the actively-marketed SKU at multiple current distributors, so the entry is kept under the seed's MO55 name to match dominant retail listings as of 2026-08-05.

products.name: Delmhorst BD-2100 Digital Pin Moisture Meter
products.priceNote: Standard package (BD-2100/PKG) list price $490.00; flooring package (BD-2100/26) $530.00 and complete dual-electrode package (BD-2100/26/21) $625-730 seen across Test Equipment Depot/ABQ Industrial/Walmart. Delmhorst sells only through a dealer network, not direct.

specs.material_calibration_groups: Wood scale, gypsum/sheetrock scale, 0-100 reference scale for other materials

products.provenance: Retailer spec sheets (ABQ Industrial, Forestry Suppliers, Test Equipment Depot, Walmart) reproducing Delmhorst's manufacturer data confirm the three-scale design (6-40% wood, 0.2-50% gypsum, 0-100 relative reference), 5/16 in. integral contact pins with interchangeable electrode support, up to 100 accumulated/averaged readings, built-in calibration check, adjustable audible alarm, 9V battery, and 1-year warranty. ABQ Industrial's own listing flags the BD-2100 as discontinued in favor of the newer Delmhorst BDX-20, but the BD-2100 remains the actively listed and sold SKU at Forestry Suppliers, Test Equipment Depot, and Walmart as of 2026-08-05, so it is kept under its seed name. No formal ±% accuracy figure was located on any fetched source, so accuracy is left null. No independently verifiable, directly-hosted product image URL could be resolved, so the image field is omitted.

products.name: Wagner Meters Orion 950 Smart Pinless Wood Moisture Meter
products.priceNote: Current price on shop.wagnermeters.com and matched at GlobalTestSupply, both $645.00.

specs.material_calibration_groups: Wood species settings booklet; relative measurement mode for drywall, plywood, OSB, MDF

products.provenance: Wagner's own shop page confirms $645 price, 4.0-32.0% wood MC range, dual pinless sensing depth (0.25 in. shallow / 0.75 in. deep), 2.0x2.5 in. scanning area, built-in temperature/RH sensor with Auto-EMC/dew point/GPP-GPK calculations, relative mode for non-wood building materials, Bluetooth app integration, 100-reading storage, HOLD function, 9V battery, and 7-year warranty. No formal ±% accuracy spec or audible-alarm feature is published on the manufacturer page, so both are left null rather than assumed.

products.name: Lignomat mini-Ligno E/D Pin Moisture Meter
products.priceNote: Current price on Lignomat's own site (lignomatusa.com), $125.00; Woodcraft lists $119.99.
products.provenance: Lignomat's own product page (item ED-0) confirms 6-45% range, built-in pins with two pin-pair lengths (3/16 in. and 7/16 in. sensing depth), 2 wood-group correction settings, LED display with 0.1%/1% step resolution, automatic pre-measurement calibration check, 9V battery, 8 oz weight, and 2-year warranty (lifetime on the display). No HOLD button or audible alarm is listed among the meter's features, so both are set false rather than left ambiguous.

products.name: Protimeter BLD5365 SurveyMaster Dual-Function Moisture Meter
products.priceNote: Current retail at Extreme Supplies Store ($749.99); an earlier/lower-spec BLD5360 variant was seen listed at Test Equipment Depot for $491.95. Protimeter sells through authorized distributors, not direct consumer pricing.

specs.measurement_range_pct: Pin: 8-99% WME (readings above 30% relative); Pinless: 60-1000 (relative scale)
specs.material_calibration_groups: Wood, drywall, building materials, concrete, fiberglass boat hulls

products.provenance: Protimeter's own 2024-model page confirms dual pin/non-invasive operation, the world's-original/best-selling positioning, larger display, automatic calibration check every 50 power cycles, user field calibration for non-invasive mode, Bluetooth to the Protimeter Connect app, and 2-year warranty. Numeric ranges (8-99% WME pin; 60-1000 relative pinless up to 0.75 in./19mm deep), 8 oz weight, and 7.5x2.75x1.9 in. dimensions confirmed via Extreme Supplies Store's reproduction of the manufacturer spec sheet for the current BLD5365 model. No formal ±% accuracy figure is published for either mode, so left null; audible alarm presence not documented on reachable sources, left null.

products.name: Calculated Industries 7445 AccuMASTER Duo Pro Pin & Pinless Moisture Meter
products.priceNote: Discontinued by Calculated Industries and out of stock everywhere checked (GlobalTestSupply, Amazon, eBay listings all show no current live price); superseded by the 7440 AccuMASTER XT. Left null rather than guessed from historical listings.

specs.material_calibration_groups: Wood, lumber, firewood, drywall, plaster, brick, concrete

products.provenance: GlobalTestSupply's spec reproduction (reflecting the manufacturer sheet) confirms dual pin (15mm stainless pins) and pinless sensor-pad operation, 5-50%/1.5-33% pin ranges, 0.1-100% pinless range up to 3/4 in. deep, ±(3%+3digit)/±3% accuracy, large white-LED-backlit display, HOLD function, and 9V battery with 3-minute auto-off. The independent review site moisturemeter.com corroborates the model and flags it as having weak accuracy below 8% MC. Both sources mark the unit discontinued/out of stock as of 2026-08-05, so priceUsd is left null rather than sourced from stale cached listings.

products.name: Tramex CME5 Concrete Moisture Encounter
products.priceNote: Current retail at Tools4Flooring ($645.00); other distributors (Big Rock Supply, Shop Excel Supplies) list similar street pricing. Tramex sells through a dealer network, not direct.
products.provenance: Tramex's own product page confirms the CME5 as a non-destructive analog concrete moisture meter reading 0-6% (with anhydrite/concrete CM-equivalent scales), ~20mm (3/4 in.) sensing depth via spring-loaded contact pins (no drilling), HOLD function to freeze readings, Bluetooth connectivity to the Tramex Meters app, ABS body, 2xAA-LR6 alkaline power, 12.1 oz weight, and ASTM F2659 support. No dedicated audible-alarm feature or formal ±% accuracy spec is documented on the manufacturer page (accuracy is expressed via gravimetric-correlation methodology, not a single number), so accuracy is left null and audible_alarm set false.

products.name: Dr.meter MD-812 Digital Wood Moisture Meter
products.priceNote: No current live price could be confirmed: Dr.meter's own site (drmeter.com) no longer lists the MD-812 in its active Moisture Meter collection, and Amazon/Walmart product pages returned bot-verification blocks on direct fetch. Left null rather than guessed; historically sold in the $18-25 range per third-party price-history sites.

image.license: OEM design (Shenzhen Handsome Technology / Walcom Int'l), sold under Dr.meter branding

products.provenance: Amazon listing copy (indexed via search) confirms Dr.meter branding, 5-40% range, ±1% accuracy, 1% resolution, 2-pin sensor, 9V battery, 130x64x32mm dimensions, ~116g weight, and data-hold (freeze reading) function. The identical device is manufactured/sold as an OEM design (meter8.com, Shenzhen Handsome Technology / Walcom Int'l) under the same MD812 model number, corroborating specs and supplying the only independently verifiable product image found. Dr.meter's own current site collection no longer lists the MD-812 among its active moisture-meter SKUs, and retailer pages (Walmart, direct Amazon re-fetch) returned bot-verification walls, so audible_alarm and sensing_depth_in are left null and priceUsd could not be confirmed live.

products.name: Sonin 50218 Digital Moisture Meter
products.priceNote: Current price on Sonin's own store (sonin.com), $77.99.
products.provenance: Sonin's own store page confirms $77.99 price, 5-40% range, 1% resolution, large LCD display, single 9V battery (not included), protective cap, replacement pins, and carrying case. No HOLD/peak function or audible alarm is listed among the product's features (unlike the pricier combination meters in this roster), so both are set false. Independent testing cited by moisturemeter.com notes the unit underestimates wood MC below ~12%, a known accuracy limitation not quantified as a formal ±% spec by Sonin, so accuracy is left null.
